transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because I've been getting a bit stuck on... on how my face looks lately. 

Just... around my jaw, mostly. It looks sagging, and one side is really uneven. I, uh, I really started noticing it after seeing myself in a bunch of recent family photos. Now I just kind of fixate on it. My wife says she barely notices anything. Same with my clients at work, they don't seem to see it, but... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Is this concern about your face affecting your daily life or relationships in any way?

Well... I suppose it is a little. I mean, I still get my work done. But... I guess I've been a bit slower getting out the door for client meetings lately. Just... checking the mirror before I leave. And sometimes during appointments, I'm... maybe not entirely present. 

Outside of work... I don't know. I guess I've skipped a few art openings recently. I just... didn't really want to be seen. Or, you know, photographed again.
Do you think that others would notice this unevenness and sagging if they looked closely at your face?
I mean... I don't know. Maybe. If they really stared. But I... I don't think they're looking that closely. At least, I hope not.
Do you think your face actually looks uneven and sagging, or is it just that you feel like it does?

I... I don't really know. I mean, when I look in the mirror, it looks uneven to me. I see it. But... I guess I'm not sure if it's actually as bad as it seems to me, or if I'm just... focusing on it too much.
Do you think it's possible that your face looks normal and you're just perceiving it as uneven and sagging?
I suppose it's possible. It's... hard to say. I just know what I see when I look, but... yeah, maybe. I really couldn't say for sure.
Do you think that someone else, like a doctor or a photographer, would be able to see this unevenness and sagging if they looked at your face?

I... maybe a photographer would. I don't really know. That's sort of what brings me in, honestly. I just keep getting stuck on this... this sagging, uneven look around my jaw. On one side of my face. 

It really started bothering me after seeing myself in a bunch of recent family photos. But... my wife says she barely notices anything. And my clients at work don't seem to see it either. So... I'm not really sure what a professional would see.
Has your concern about the unevenness and sagging of your face been constant since you first noticed it, or have you had times when it bothered you less?
I don't know if it's constant. It just... bothers me when I think about it, I guess. Sometimes I don't think about it as much.
Do you think that other people would see your face as perfectly normal if they looked at it?

I don't really know. I guess... maybe they would. Like I said, my wife doesn't seem to notice anything wrong, so... yeah, it's possible they just see a normal face. I couldn't really tell you for sure.
Do you think that your perception of your face being uneven and sagging might be different from how it actually looks?
I suppose... it's possible. I mean, if my wife doesn't see it, maybe it's not as bad as I think. I just... I don't know. It's hard to say.
Do you find it difficult to stop thinking about the appearance of your face?

Yeah, I guess it is hard to stop thinking about it sometimes. That's... kind of why I'm here. I just keep getting stuck on it, you know? The sagging, and how uneven it looks around my jaw and... the one side of my face. It really started bothering me after I saw myself in all those family photos we took recently. I just keep focusing on it, even though, like I said, my wife says she barely notices anything. And my clients at work don't seem to care either. But I just... I can't seem to let it go.
How much distress would you say this concern about your face is causing you?
I don't really know. I wouldn't exactly call it distress, I guess. It's just... annoying. It just bugs me, that's all. Not a huge deal, but... yeah.
Has your concern about your face's appearance affected your relationships with friends or family members?

Not really with my family, no. Um... I mean, I still get through my work just fine. It's just... I guess I've been a little slower getting out the door for client meetings lately. Maybe a bit less present when I'm actually in the appointments. 

And with friends... I don't know, I did skip a few art openings recently. I just... I didn't really want to be seen. Or photographed. But that's about it.
Are there any daily activities that you've stopped doing or are doing less often because of your concerns about your face?

I mean... like I just mentioned, really. I still do my work fine. It just... takes me a little longer to get out the door for those client meetings. And maybe I'm a bit distracted during them. 

And... yeah, skipping those art openings so I don't have to be seen or photographed. But other than that... no. Not really. Just what I said.
Is your concern only about your face or are there other parts of your body that you also worry about?
Um... no. Just my face. I don't really think about anything else like that. Just... what we've been talking about.
Is there something specific about the unevenness and sagging that bothers you the most, or is it more the general appearance of your face?

Um... I guess it's more specific. Just... this sagging around my jaw. And one side of my face just looks... uneven. 

I don't know, I saw some family photos recently and I just keep getting stuck on it. My wife says she barely notices anything... same with my clients. But... yeah. That's what bothers me.
Do you find yourself thinking about the appearance of your face at times when you're not in front of a mirror or about to be seen by others?

Um... no, not really. I mean, mostly it's just when I'm at the mirror or getting ready to head out. Once I'm actually working or... just doing other things, I don't really dwell on it. So... no. I don't think so.
Do you ever find yourself thinking about your face's appearance when you're trying to focus on something else?
Um... no. Like I just said, not really. If I'm working on a client's portfolio or... just busy with something else, I'm focused on that. It doesn't really distract me.
Do you feel like you're unable to control your thoughts about your face's appearance?
Um... no. I can control what I think about. It's not like that. I just... I see it in the mirror and I don't like it. That's really all it is.
Is it just the sagging and unevenness around your jaw that bothers you, or do you also wish you could change other aspects of your face?
No, just... just the jaw area. I'm not really looking to change anything else. That's it.
